== Notes ==
* Combines well with [[Artificer's Insignia]].
* This skill, [[Ether Feast]], and [[Drain Enchantment]] are the only Mesmer skills that heal the user.
{{bug|Similarly to  [[Illusionary Weaponry]] and [["I Am Unstoppable!"]], the armor provided by this skill is only applied at the end of the [[armor calculation]]. As such, it is not counted in the [[effect stacking#Effect caps|bonus armor cap]] of +25 and is not reduced by [[Armor penetration]].}}
{{bug|Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not [[health gain]].}}
